title: API Wrapper Around Postcodes.io
text: API wrapper around postcodes.io - free UK postcode lookup geocoder. package helps find transform information UK administrative geography like postcodes, LSOA, MSOA, constituencies, counties, wards, districts, CCG NUTS. package based exclusively open data provided postcodes.io. PostcodesioR can used data scientists social scientists working geocoded UK data. common task working data aggregating geocoded data different administrative levels, e.g. turning postcode-level data counties regions. package can help achieving many cases changing aggregation geographic data required.

Returns NAs postcode exist (404). postcode Postcode. current ('live') postcodes within United Kingdom, Channel Islands Isle Man, received monthly Royal Mail. 2, 3 4-character outward code, single space 3-character inward code. quality Positional Quality. Ordnance Survey postcode grid reference Easting 1 metre resolution; blank postcodes Channel Islands Isle Man. Grid references postcodes Northern Ireland relate Irish Grid system. northings Northings. WGS84 longitude given Postcode's national grid reference. latitude Latitude. WGS84 latitude given Postcode's national grid reference. european_electoral_region European Electoral Region (EER). European Electoral Region code postcode. primary_care_trust Primary Care Trust (PCT). code Primary Care areas England, LHBs Wales, CHPs Scotland, LCG Northern Ireland PHD Isle Man; equivalent areas Channel Islands. Clinical commissioning groups (CCGs) NHS organisations set Health Social Care Act 2012 organise delivery NHS services England. nuts Nomenclature Units Territorial Statistics (NUTS) / Local Administrative Units (LAU) areas. LAU2 code postcode. NUTS hierarchical classification spatial units provides breakdown European Union's territory producing regional statistics comparable across Union. NUTS area classification United Kingdom comprises current national administrative electoral areas, except Scotland NUTS areas comprise whole /part Local Enterprise Regions. NUTS levels 1-3 frozen minimum three years NUTS levels 4 5 now Local Administrative Units (LAU) levels 1 2 respectively. _code Returns ID Code associated postcode. Typically 9 character code known ONS Code GSS Code. currently available districts, parishes, counties, CCGs, NUTS wards. See https://postcodes.io/docs details.
